nodes.titleZh: 過去進行式與 when / while
nodes.titleEn: Past Continuous with When and While
nodes.communicativeGoalZh: 描述過去某時正在進行的背景動作，以及被另一事件打斷的關係。
nodes.form: was/were + V-ing; when + event; while + ongoing action

naturalExamples.text: I was reading when the phone rang.
They were playing soccer at four.
While Mom was cooking, I set the table.
It was raining when we left school.

wrong.text: I was read when the phone rang.

better.text: I was reading when the phone rang.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: 過去進行式使用 was/were + V-ing。

wrong.text: While the bell rang, we were studying.

better.text: When the bell rang, we were studying.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: 短暫發生的 bell rang 通常以 when 引入。

wrong.text: He slept when I came home.

better.text: He was sleeping when I came home.

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: 要強調我到家那一刻正在持續的背景動作，使用 was sleeping。

wrong.text: They was waiting for the bus.

better.text: They were waiting for the bus.

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: 複數主詞 they 搭配 were。

nodes.communicativeGoalZh: 用形容詞描述名詞或主詞，用副詞描述動作方式。
nodes.form: adjective + noun / be + adjective; verb + adverb

naturalExamples.text: She is a careful student.
She checks her work carefully.
The soup smells good.
Ben runs fast.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: 名詞 boy 前使用形容詞 careful。
描述 speaks 的方式通常用副詞 well。

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: 正式基礎用法以副詞 slowly 描述 walks。
smell 在這裡是連綴動詞，後接形容詞。

acceptableVariants.noteZh: fast 和 hard 本身可作副詞；不要造出 fastly，hardly 的意思則是「幾乎不」。

nodes.communicativeGoalZh: 比較兩者或三者以上，並清楚指出比較對象。

naturalExamples.text: Mia is taller than Ben.
This book is more interesting than that one.
Leo is the fastest runner in the class.
My bag is as heavy as yours.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: 比較級只標示一次，不同時使用 more 和 -er。
good 的最高級是不規則形式 best。

wrong.text: This road is short than that road.

better.text: This road is shorter than that road.

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: 兩者比較使用 shorter than。

chineseTransferBugs.zh: 這是三個方案中最方便的。

wrong.text: This is the more convenient of the three plans.

better.text: This is the most convenient of the three plans.

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: 三者以上選最高程度，使用 most。

acceptableVariants.noteZh: 兩種形式都可見；friendlier 較常見。

nodes.communicativeGoalZh: 依可數與不可數名詞選擇 many、much、few、little、fewer、less。

naturalExamples.text: How many books do you have?
We don't have much time.
There are a few apples left.
This bottle has less water.

wrong.text: How much books do you need?

better.text: How many books do you need?

contrastPairs.reasonZh: books 是複數可數名詞，使用 many。
正式用法中，複數可數名詞 bottles 使用 fewer。

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: time 在這個意思中不可數，使用 a little。

wrong.text: There are little students in the class.

better.text: There are few students in the class.

acceptableVariants.noteZh: less + 複數在口語中常見；正式寫作優先使用 fewer people。

nodes.titleEn: Modal Functions: Advice, Obligation, and Possibility
nodes.communicativeGoalZh: 依溝通目的選擇 should、must、have to、may、might、could。
nodes.form: modal + base verb; have to + base verb

naturalExamples.text: You should get more sleep.
Students must wear a helmet here.
I have to finish my homework.
It might rain this afternoon.

wrong.text: You must to wear a helmet.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: 情態動詞不因第三人稱加 -s。

wrong.text: You should to take a break.

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: 只有可能性時用 might；must 會表達更強的確定或義務。

diagnostics.promptZh: 哪一句最符合本節點的自然英文形式？

choices.text: You must to wear a helmet.

diagnostics.promptZh: 哪一句在一般情境中最自然，也不會改變核心意思？

nodes.titleZh: to + V 與 V-ing 搭配
nodes.communicativeGoalZh: 在高頻動詞與介系詞後選擇常見的 to + V 或 V-ing 形式。
nodes.form: want/need/plan + to V; enjoy/finish + V-ing; preposition + V-ing

naturalExamples.text: I want to read this book.
We plan to leave early.
She enjoys drawing.
Ben is good at swimming.

better.text: I want to read this book.

contrastPairs.reasonZh: want 後面通常接 to + 原形。

wrong.text: He finished to clean his room.

better.text: We decided to take the bus.

chineseTransferBugs.reasonZh: decide 後通常接 to + V。

acceptableVariants.noteZh: 兩種形式通常都自然，語意重點可能因情境略有不同。
